note: Do not edit datasets or thresholds to force drift. If the model's outputs did not drift, the 'alert' screen becomes Monitor > Alerts > Alert rules showing the rule, and the narration is adjusted. Re-takes need fresh window labels (baseline2/current2).
prepare: # owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-08 -l swedencentral -o none

$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-08 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p developerPrincipalId=$me --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'deployment to rg-mglab-ai-08 failed' }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 300   # role assignment propagation (up to 5 minutes)
python -m hrmon.traffic --data data/golden.jsonl --window warmup --aoai-endpoint $env:AOAI --appinsights $env:APPINSIGHTS | Out-Null   # warm-up: 16 triaged, 0 failed

screens.name: kql
steps: Open the Log Analytics workspace in rg-mglab-ai-08 > Logs
Run: AppTraces | where Message == "triage" | summarize n=count() by window=tostring(Properties["hr_window"]), lang=tostring(Properties["hr_lang"]) | order by window
Show the table (optionally the column chart) with English and Portuguese counts per window
mask: tenant name / directory in the top bar
signed-in user name, UPN and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: monitor
mask: the workspace id is only in an environment variable; never echo it

screens.name: alert
prepare: Start-Sleep -Seconds 600   # the alert rule runs every 5 minutes; fires 5-20 minutes after the monitor run
steps: Open Monitor > Alerts and filter the resource group to rg-mglab-ai-08
Show the condition (query on AppTraces drift_report, Count > 0) and the fired time
mask: tenant name / directory in the top bar
signed-in user name, UPN and avatar in the account menu
resource names in the alert details

teardown: az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-08 -n $env:AOAI_NAME -l swedencentral
